# Fixture: identity-access-boundary-v1

**Synthetic.** Generated by `research/scripts/build_boundary_fixture.py`. All
identifiers carry a `lab-` prefix, and all addresses come from the ranges
reserved for documentation.

## What it is for

Fifteen hand-placed cases at the edges of the five detection rules:
thresholds, window limits, events at the same instant, arrival order, and three
situations the rules are known to miss. Each case's expected outcome was written
into the rule contracts (`research/rules/*.toml`), and their hashes were recorded in
`docs/PROGRESS.md`, before this fixture or any rule code existed.

It is not a sample of real activity, and it was written by the same author as
the rules. It shows whether the rules behave as their contracts say at the
edges, and makes their known blind spots visible as measured misses.

## Files

| File | Source id | Ingested? | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events.jsonl` | `identity-access-boundary-v1` | yes | The identity provider's events, in creation order, not shuffled |
| `events-hr.jsonl` | `identity-access-boundary-v1-hr` | yes, as a separate source | One account disable recorded by an HR system (case B-12) |
| `labels.jsonl` | — | **never** | Ground truth, one line per event in both files |
| `MANIFEST.json` | — | no | Hashes, the two sources, expected ingestion counts, the case list |

## Cases

| Case | Rule | Situation | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-01 | IA-003 | 4 failures, then success | silent |
| B-02 | IA-003 | 5 failures, the first exactly 30 min 00 s before the success | fires |
| B-03 | IA-003 | As B-02, the first failure 30 min 01 s before | silent |
| B-04 | IA-003 | 5 failures from 5 addresses, then success | fires |
| B-05 | IA-003 | Failures by one account, success by another | silent |
| B-06 | IA-005 | Restricted export exactly 60 min 00 s after an unapproved grant | fires |
| B-07 | IA-005 | Export 60 min 01 s after the grant | silent |
| B-08 | IA-005 | Grant to one principal, export by another | silent |
| B-09 | IA-004 | Sign-in at the same instant as the disable | silent |
| B-10 | IA-004 | Sign-in after the disable, written earlier in the file | fires |
| B-11 | IA-004 | Re-enabled without approval, then a sign-in | silent (design choice) |
| B-12 | IA-004 | Disable recorded by the HR source, sign-in by the identity provider | **silent — known miss** |
| B-13 | IA-001 | Admin role granted without approval; the source omits `privileged` | **silent — known miss** |
| B-14 | IA-002 | Privileged sign-in; the source omits `mfa_used` | **silent — known miss** |
| B-15 | IA-003 | 5 failures, then two successes a minute apart | fires once |

The known misses are labelled `suspicious`, because in reality they are. The
evaluation therefore counts them as missed detections.

## Regenerating

```bash
python research/scripts/build_boundary_fixture.py --check
python research/scripts/build_boundary_fixture.py
```

Frozen: changing a case means a new fixture with a new source id.
